text:
Kira: behold, Pico the parrot discovered toast crumbs on the kitchen counter and immediately declared it his new hoard. :parrot: :bread:
Eli: photo or the crumbs never existed. :stuck_out_tongue:
Kira: uploaded an image: https://i.imgur.com/ToastParrot.jpg (do not underestimate the intensity) :eyes:
Priya: that head tilt is a full investigative committee meeting. Pico is judging our snack choices. :joy:
Sam: poll: should Pico get a dedicated emoji? options: (1) yes, honor the crumbs (2) yes, but only for bread-related threads (3) absolutely not, he will demand royalties
ops-bot: Poll created: "Pico emoji?" Options: Yes / Bread-only / No. 9 votes so far.
Eli: also, how long until Pico starts a tiny breadcrumb shrine? asking for a friend. :laughing:
Kira: update: he has a small pile under his favorite perch. it's curated. :sparkles:
Priya: reaction: :heartpulse: this is the best thing i've seen all week. thanks for sharing!
Kira: Pico sends a theatrical squawk and a crumb-laden wink. <3
